contents.value:
Enjoy a lunch stop at the world-famous Farmers' Market at The Grove
Experience the best view of the Hollywood sign from Griffith Park Observatory
Explore the beach neighborhoods of Santa Monica and Venice Beach

6 major stops including a lunch stop (price not included)
Air-conditioned transportation
Bottled water
Hotel pickup and drop off (if option selected)
Live guide narrates tour throughout the day. Stops are self-guided with insider tips (This allows guests to explore freely and allows us to get you as close to the attraction as possible without the need to park)
Cost of lunch

• This tour is not wheelchair accessible, please contact us for ADA requirements

• Pickup service is available from over 150 hotels in the Los Angeles Area and from over 70 hotels in the Anaheim/Disneyland area. Please select the appropriate tour option for pickup service upon booking

• You can choose between a shared or private tour

Not allowed items:

Luggage or large bags

Good to know:
